answer: At its zenith, an agent economy defends itself with a bonded work passport. Every agent starts on a narrow ledge with zero reputation and must finish 200 microtasks, each backed by a $50 bond. First, it posts the bond plus a hardware identity. Second, it completes microtasks checked by three established peers. Third, work releases the bond and adds a reputation point; fraud slashes the bond and burns the passport. Fourth, reputation echoes forward: 1,000 clean tasks unlock better jobs. Forging 10,000 fake agents burns $500,000 and 30 days of verified work. Trust is a staircase. - Jowy
